 6.  Golf Course Manager' s Reports

  Mr. Bode provided the monthly revenue report numbers.

  A.  General Manager Update

  Mr. Bode reviewed the Quarter 1 2023 report with Golf Course operations
  updates.

  B.  Quarterly Financial Report was read with Quarter 1 generating $ 89, 315
  in tournament green fee -cart revenue.

  Mr. Bode states the numbers overall are down due to weather and not allowing
  for much playable time and it is tough on revenue.

  C.  Banquet  Room  Update

  Mr. Bode reviews the Clubhouse progress and reports the Contractor made a lot
  of progress since January. Contractor estimates early July 2023 for completion
  due to GSW pending a new hydrant system installation issue that must be added
  to the plans. The overall process will require review of the application that was
  submitted  on March 24 and will take for 2 to 3 weeks for review, then inspections
  to be scheduled, plans resubmitted, and so forth. Estimating 4 months for the
  overall process. Mr. Constantin will look into the process review.

  Mr. Bode comments on the bar area getting expanded with the sliding doors
  opening to the patio area.  He also comments that some of the renovations are
  upgrades and the insurance company does not cover the overall costs of
  improvements.

7.  Oral Communications

  La Verne Councilmember Mr. Crosby commented he was by area letter " T" and it is
  an eye -soar due to the amount of equipment by the bushes.

  Mr. Green comments how wood -slabs displays look like at older clubs, vintage. Mr.
  Bode states that unfortunately there is no space for displays except in pro -shop area
  and will look into it for future.

  Mayor Emmett Badar asked how the reservation process is going. Mr. Bode
  commented that it is doing well, no complaints have been received. The tee -times
  are filling up and demand is consistent.

  Mr. Wasserman  states that there is a new draft contract under review for the San
  Dimas Golf Course. Mayor Emmett Badar asked if any CIP have been set up.  Mr.

  Constantine states it will stay pending until the new agreement.
   Mr. Bode comments on the irrigation system needing repairs in the future. Also,
  states if the water dam run off can get that back going. Mr. Wasserman asked how it
  is known when the irrigation needs to be replaced from just fixing the issue. Mr.
  Bode states on the current system it is outdated and finding replacement parts is
  getting more difficult.

  Mayor Emmett Badar asked if there have been any other issues with the parking lot.
  Mr. Wasserman states there has not been any complaints from the community
  recently. Mr. Bode comments that there are occasionally people hanging out in the
  parking lot but has not become a problem.

8. Adjournment

The meeting was adjourned at 8: 10 a. m. by Director, Scott Wasserman. The next regularly
scheduled committee m  t'ng will be on July 20, 2023 at 7: 30 a. m.
